title: Trigun Stargaze: What a Wonderful World
original_title: トライガン スターゲイズ ： ホワット ア ワンダフル ワールド
overview: Two and a half years after the JuLai tragedy, the planet plunges into further chaos. As Midvalley the Hornfreak launches a devastating assault on Home, Nicholas D. Wolfwood is forced into a brutal standalone confrontation to protect the defenseless, while Vash races against time to intervene.
